brief:
Gadi Eisenkot, a former Israeli military chief, is attempting a low-profile campaign to remove Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu from power, according to Al-Monitor. Eisenkot typically dresses in plain black, speaks halting English, and responds in interviews using bullet-point lists—habits shaped by his military background.

The effort represents a potential challenge to Netanyahu's political dominance, though details of Eisenkot's specific strategy and political base remain limited in available reporting.
dek: Gadi Eisenkot, the man who could unseat Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, almost always dresses in plain black, speaks halting English and, reflecting the military culture that shapes him, responds in interviews in bullet-point lists.
title: Israeli military figure Eisenkot mounts quiet challenge to Netanyahu
